base_protocol.arrival_model: independent Poisson arrivals per second; common tape across budgets
base_protocol.dispatch: global synchronous frames; released jobs only; FIFO within class
base_protocol.score: queue weighted actual frame departures divided by actual frame duration
base_protocol.budget_unit: candidate construction or feasibility attempt; seeds included
base_protocol.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at horizon, then drain the same finite prefix

protocol.role: development only; consumed real arrival seeds
protocol.single_change: each successor fills lanes sequentially; at each lane choose nonempty temporary queue maximizing q_i/mu_i, take its largest fitting pure profile, then decrement temporary queue
protocol.successor_frame: ordered selected profile indices; class service is accumulated; duration is max of idle and selected effective durations; unused lanes remain idle
protocol.unchanged: raw Poisson current search, paid pool, support cap, recovery, shared path and horizon, first frame, q_i/mu_i priority, original-mu fluid tail and final candidate tie break
protocol.budget: one fully constructed feasible successor frame is one attempt; two successors per contender remain four paid attempts, so root+successors <= K
protocol.extra_work: lane positions visited (including the first empty position, then stop), each nonempty priority coordinate, profile probes and assigned-profile temporary queue updates are reported; priority/profile/update fields are subtotals of existing native counters
protocol.controls: v4 36, analytic 36 and raw Poisson 108; reproduce all 180 runs and deterministic counters
protocol.pairing: same load, real seed, K and planning seed; average run ratios within real seed, then across real seeds

frozen_state_diagnostic.target: same fixed contenders and retained CV-first-minus-raw-first common-v4 effects; no new real trajectory replay
frozen_state_diagnostic.measure: paired mixed-minus-raw fixed-contender margins and oriented target residuals; structural checks only

protocol.stopping_rule: 288 full runs once and all 63 frozen states x64 samples; no coefficients, seed additions, state filtering or post-result changes

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

certificates.arrival_model: independent Poisson job arrivals in physical time
certificates.drift_bound: E[Delta V | Q] <= B + tau_max*C - tau_min*effective_slack*sum(Q)
certificates.capacity_basis: lanes times convex hull of all admitted lane requirements/max(1,duration)

limitations: Targets reuse consumed development trajectories, with overlapping futures and repeated states; case counts are occurrences, not independent replicates or whole-policy effects.
Changing successor construction changes the fixed-action proxy expectation. Variance ratios and paired Monte Carlo standard errors are descriptive, with sample ids crossed across states.
Realized-minus-proxy residuals mix arrival-tape noise, horizon cutoff, and hybrid-model versus v4 continuation; they do not identify pure model bias.

All new searches, path draws and mixed lane-filling work are charged. Native totals include separately reported coordinate and profile subcounts; frozen target-replay work is reused and not charged as new work.
Sequential q/mu lane filling is a deterministic continuation heuristic; it does not optimize all feasible joint successor frames.
The candidate-attempt budget is unchanged, but mixed construction performs more per-lane work; operation counts and measured time remain material.
Only two successor frames are discrete; the fluid tail and single-sample final comparison remain approximations.

Full runs reuse development seeds. Frozen states were selected from earlier disagreements, and overlapping retained intervention effects are not independent policy outcomes or pure model-bias estimates.
